title: #271 Automobiles
prompt: Some people think that the automobile has improved modern life. Others think that the automobile has caused serious problems. What’s your opinion about it?

Others think that the automobile has caused serious problems.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The automobile makes travel easier by allowing people to reach distant places.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The automobile helps people get to work quickly, improving daily routines.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cars create bad traffic and pollution in cities, leading to health issues because they use gasoline.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cars require large amounts of space for roads and parking lots, preventing the use of land for parks or homes.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The car has greatly improved how people can travel and go places.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The car has greatly improved how people can travel and go places.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another benefit of the automobile is that it helps businesses grow and connect communities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another benefit of the automobile is that it helps businesses grow and connect communities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The car has not truly improved modern life because its negative impacts, such as traffic congestion and environmental damage, are too great to ignore.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
